item.title: Dolly Parton To Be Honored With Two-Day DOLLYFEST in 2027
item.description:
Trending on Billboard
Music icon Dolly Parton‘s life and career is set to be honored with the two-day festival DOLLYFEST, set for Nashville, Tenn. and London, England, across two consecutive weekends in 2027.
Explore Dolly Parton See latest videos, charts and news
The event had originally been planned as a multi-artist event for January 2026 and was slated to feature Parton as both a performer and host. The fest will now transform into an international, two-day and double-weekend party to honor the multi-hyphenate singer, songwriter, entertainer, philanthropist, author and businesswoman.
“What Dolly started, we will ensure is brought to life,” Danny Nozell, Founder/CEO of CTK Enterprises, said in a statement. “Many people behind the scenes know that DOLLYFEST is a dream of Dolly’s that was intended to take place on her 80th birthday in Nashville.
